title: Raymond Carless and the best drummers he had
summary: He praises drummers Russ and Raymond Carless, and mentions trumpeters who alternated.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Carlos, yeah. Drum player. Yeah, drum player.
That's funny. You never met him?

No, you never did meet him, but I'm happy to meet him. He's the one that Russ taught how to play drums. You see, it was hard to get the kind of drum players we needed, anybody to hold a pair of sticks, you understand what I mean? But you see, all that old hard music and things we would have. We needed a good drummer. We needed a good drummer. We had a small outfit too, you see. And we had to click because we used to broadcast every Saturday morning over WWL, Mr. Dupree was our announcer from Chinatown, and all those different little gigs, and there was people from all over coming there listening to that.
Who were the best drummer you had you think? Russ was the best drummer.

Yeah. Russ was the best. See, Russ played bass, trumpet, and drum, but his first instrument was drum. He was a good timekeeper. Yeah, he got his son was good too. This boy Raymond is good, you understand me? He's good too. All them boys was good. You see what the whole set up of it is, was that like I told you, we had to have somebody, because we played flow shows. And Oral Palmer, his mom and them used to be on the flow shows. See we used to play flow shows and everything. Oral Palmer used to be one of them one foot drummers, the one foot tap dancers, he used to be with Thelma Therfield was his mother's name. His auntie used to go from one nightclub to another, you know, put on a show at this one, and maybe Briscoe and all that, once we put up in the old line of the French Quarter to come up there. And that's what we had for. And Eric Schuyper got it, and he was one of the best trumpet players we had. And well I had some other guys alternating. I played Gilbert, Gilbert Young played with me, and this guy I knew you knew. And Leslie got a drum player down in the French Quarter, Ricard, he played with me too. Ricard? Alex, Alexis, you know.
